binaryPath.description: Path or command to the sulcus-local binary

serverUrl.description: Remote Sulcus server URL (overrides sulcus.ini). E.g. https://sulcus.dforge.ca

serverApiKey.description: Remote Sulcus server API key (overrides sulcus.ini). Useful for headless or CI environments.

iniPath.description: Absolute path to sulcus.ini (defaults to <project-root>/sulcus.ini derived from binaryPath)

commands.name: join
commands.description: Join a Sulcus collective. Exchanges an invitation token for an API key and writes it to sulcus.ini.
